zh-CN.title: 足迹筛选、打卡历史与系统消息优化
items: 系统消息按用户身份展示“我”，足迹分享消息可点击查看；聊天外观预览移除足迹场景
科研、活动与足迹使用统一圆形成员头像，足迹支持筛选成员并保留自己的足迹
足迹面板按年月展示最近 20 条首次打卡记录，同一地区重复打卡不增加历史

en.title: Footprint filters, history and clearer system messages
items: System messages resolve identities and highlight Me, with a footprint shortcut; appearance previews no longer include footprint cards
Research, activities and footprints share circular member avatars; footprint filters always retain your own map
Footprints show up to 20 first check-ins by month; repeat visits to a region do not add history
